summary: Recognize the supervised replication worker when an alternate service namespace is installed but unloaded and not enabled, and warn on failed worker authorization.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

compatibility.detail: Systemd lookup ignores unloaded alternate-family staging only beside a running or enabled family and after checking local user-unit search paths for masks, unusable links and target wants/requires dependencies, including aliases. Active, enabled, masked and unknown alternate installations still conflict. Failed worker authorization and blocking-task errors are logged at warn at most once per minute per process, with the connector PID, supervisor unit candidates and error chain, without process environments.

downtime.detail: No service is renamed, enabled or restarted by this change.

manual.detail: No service migration is performed or required.

recovery.detail: Existing service files and enablement links are unchanged.
